three_named_causes: THE EPISODE NEVER ENDS. The declaration ends the ATTEMPT; nothing ends the stage's live EPISODE. projection.replaceable requires an ended episode whose ending is in documents.REPLACEABLE_ENDINGS, whose single member is 'abandoned-after-restart' -- the ending a manager records when a RESTART cannot account for an offer's bearer. An operator's W44716 declaration is not that ending and produces none, so manager._replace never opens a successor.

THE LINE IS STILL HELD. The abandoned attempt's writer is still 'active' and the line is still 'writing'. grant_writer admits a writer only from 'idle' or 'correction-ready', and the only thing in this build that revokes a writer is freeze_checkpoint -- which an abandoned attempt by definition never reaches.

THE WORK IS STILL GATED. The fence installs runtime-quiescence:<generation> and nothing discharges it: the ordinary discharge is an ENDING's, and this attempt has no ending to carry the positive-absence evidence the gate wants -- even though the abandonment observed exactly that absence.
